protocol.visual_unfreezing: last vision transformer block only; all other encoder parameters frozen
protocol.feature: mean of 256 final-block tokens at keyframe time index, 1024-d; connected autograd hook
protocol.crop: fixed keyframe GT box across eight neighboring frames, 2x padding, RoIAlign 224x224; not tracked boxes
protocol.split: 32 videos from existing 420-video expert partition; 8 from existing 90-video development partition; deterministic evenly spaced annotated frames
protocol.initialization: same original encoder and seed0 420-video supervised flat/phrase heads; these heads have not trained on development videos
protocol.classification: original 184-label class-weighted focal gamma=2; linear head trainable in every condition
protocol.contrastive: visual-to-fixed triplet prototypes; average log-softmax over every applicable positive class; one prototype per class, no duplicate in-batch false negatives; GT rows with no valid triplet and backgrounds excluded
protocol.aux_projection: 1024->512 initialized from existing phrase head; trainable only in contrastive condition; text prototypes frozen
protocol.pilot_scope: bounded engineering and optimization pilot, one seed, no final detector mAP or adaptation benefit claim; sampled GT plus random backgrounds, not full YOLO candidate training
protocol.checkpoint_selection: highest internal development 86-triplet crop AP among baseline and epochs; exact ties keep earlier checkpoint
